googlePlay.shortDescription: Meditation & sleep on phone, tablet and Wear OS, with home screen widgets.
googlePlay.previousFullDescription:
Free Meditation & Sleep Made Easy — Always Free.
Join 2 million+ people finding calm with Medito, your pocket‑size studio for guided meditation, mindfulness courses, breathing exercises and sleep stories. No ads. No subscriptions. Pure daily calm.

Why Medito?
• 100 % FREE & non‑profit – built by Medito Foundation to make mindfulness accessible to everyone.
• Courses for every goal – quick daily calm, focus boosts, anxiety SOS, mindful walking, loving‑kindness and more.
• Sleep stories & sounds – rain, ocean, white noise and narrated tales that turn screens‑off into lights‑out.
• Personalised programmes – 7‑day starter, 30‑day challenges and advanced packs for any situation.
• Offline mode – download any session and practise anywhere, anytime.
• Evidence‑based – a 2024 RCT proved regular Medito use boosts wellbeing (Remskar et al., 2024).
• Background audio – keep meditating or listening to sleep sounds with your screen off or while multitasking
• Wear OS – continue your pack, or play your Daily or a favourite, from your watch. The watch app works with the Medito app on your phone; without it, you can still play a free guided meditation on your watch.

How it works
- Pick a mood or goal (Calm, Sleep, Focus, Anxiety relief).
- Choose a length – 3 to 30 mins.
- Press play, breathe, enjoy.

• Track your streaks & get gentle reminders
• Meditation packs for Students, Sleep, Anxiety, Stress and more
• Dark‑mode friendly design

Install Medito now – unlimited free meditations in under a minute.
